title: Soft Cinema
one_liner: Slow, warm and filmic: giant butter-yellow words build word by word behind your head, and thin cream lowercase subtitles fill the air above you, left to right.
best_for: Calm talking heads with one big idea: a lesson, a belief, a 'here's what changed' story. Works best when there's open space above your head.
effort: Medium: film one take, pick 2-3 phrases to go giant and one payoff word for lilac; Claude does the cut, cut-out, timings and grade.

palette.use: lilac: the one payoff word in a stack
white: small connector words on darker stacks

pace: Slow: normal speed, cuts only at sentence ends (one in 18.6 s here), shots hold 4-14 s; every word hard-cuts on in one frame on its spoken syllable.
signature_moves: Giant word stacks that build word by word above and behind the head (30-55% covered by the hair), butter with one lilac payoff word
Three-slot cream subtitles: lowercase chunks hard-cut on left, centre, right along one line, then clear together; they drop out whenever a stack is up
Warm, soft cinematic grade with a darker, quieter room behind the speaker and a soft music bed 14 dB under the voice, no sound effects
